title: Ladder / Stepladder Pre-Use Inspection
name: Ladder / Stepladder Pre-Use Inspection
description: Pre-use checklist for ladders and stepladders. It supports selection and condition checks and does not replace the work-at-height risk assessment or safe system of work.

sections.title: SUITABILITY FOR THE TASK
items: A ladder is suitable for the task after considering safer work-at-height equipment
The user is competent / instructed for the equipment and task
The ladder is long / high enough without overreaching
The intended load is within the equipment rating
The work does not require unsafe side loading or prolonged use beyond the assessed method

sections.title: PRE-USE CONDITION CHECK
items: Stiles are straight and free from significant damage
Feet are present, clean and in good condition
Rungs / steps are secure, clean and undamaged
Locking mechanisms, hinges and stays operate correctly
Platforms / handrails / accessories are secure where fitted
No contamination, makeshift repair or visible defect makes the equipment unsafe

sections.title: SET-UP AND USE LOCATION
items: Ground / floor is firm, level, clean and suitable
The ladder can be secured or stabilised as required
Doors, vehicles and public / pedestrian routes cannot strike or destabilise the ladder
Overhead electrical hazards have been considered
The work area below / around the ladder is protected where necessary
